verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB has its own programmatic surfaces: an MCP server with tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring, CHKit commands to deploy schema and pipelines as code, and native ClickHouse protocol/HTTP access for all data operations. However, there is no documented management API, and no claim that UI functions such as cluster creation, resizing, alert rules, webhook destinations, SSO/roles or data sharing are available programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented control-plane/management REST API, an explicit UI–API parity claim, programmatic coverage of cluster lifecycle, alerting, access and sharing settings, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
